column1: # What a user types into the app, checked through the whole app without a screen (keyboard hook → controller →
# simulated text box and Korean IME). Every reported case goes here.
#   mode      EN or KO, the IME mode while typing
#   typed     the keys, words separated by spaces; Hangul stands for the keys that type it (KO 내 = so).
#             A space is typed at the end, or Enter when it ends in ⏎, or nothing more when it ends in .
#   expected  what the text box shows, without that last space or Enter, or = for exactly what was typed
# ID protection is off by default (Settings.ProtectIds): a name-like single word + Enter converts too
# mirrored: the same shapes typed in the other mode
# Korean mode, proper syllables and an English part of four letters or less: kept as typed (해미면 is not goal면)
# Korean mode keeps 초4가 (a 4th grader); ch4 is English-mode only
# Shift only slips on past a key that needs it, in a long word: not dkssUD, not RK는
